The sequence of actions—disabling real-time AV, disabling Sysmon logging, enabling wdigest, and escalating a service account—represented a severe security posture degradation. Investigation revealed no malicious activity on the host. The incident was triggered by a misconfigured automation script that misclassified a routine internal scan as APT behavior. The service account 'svc_forensic_tool' was used in the unauthorized sequence and has been revoked. All malicious containment actions were blocked or reversed.

timeline.description: Internal network scan from 10.0.9.50 (actually 192.168.1.100 spoofed) detected and blocked. Misattributed to 10.0.9.50.
Normal authentication event from host WS-IT-101 (10.0.2.15) by helpdesk user.
Incident ticket INC-39943 opened in ITSM for APT containment on 10.0.9.50.
Unauthorized APT containment sequence triggered via malicious playbook execution.
Firewall blocks source IP 10.0.5.14 (source of malicious command).
Service account 'svc_forensic_tool' credentials revoked due to misuse.
